notes: Original institution-authored CDS-C HTML worksheet retained by the Internet Archive. Headline C1 counts were read from the original cells; additional metrics are source-extracted. Source page 3 identifies worksheet C, not a physical PDF page.
expected.review_method: Independent reading of original C1 gender/status/residency cells and reconciliation with printed totals where provided. Additional source-extracted metrics are not all manually verified.
